title: BLEACH: TYBW Part 4 Final Trailer Previews Action Featuring Yoruichi, Aizen, Kenpachi, Urahara and More
content: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War (TYBW) revealed the final trailer for Part 4, which is subtitled The Calamity . The anime previously confirmed a July 25 premiere , set to conclude the new adaptation in Fall 2026. Studio Pierrot is in charge of the animation under its PIERROT FILMS label.
author: Anime Corner

title: MAO Anime's English Dub Debuts on August 24
content: The anime debuted on the NHK -General channel on April 4 at 11:45 p.m. (10:45 a.m. EST) and will run for two continuous cours without breaks. Hulu is streaming the anime in U.S., and on Disney+ in Canada, Latin America, Australia, and New Zealand. The second cours started with its 14th episode on Saturday.
author: ANN

title: A Returner's Magic Should Be Special Season 2 Reveals Ending Theme Song Artist
content: The staff for the second season of the anime based on Wookjakga 's A Returner's Magic Should Be Special ( Kikansha no Mahō wa Tokubetsu Desu in Japanese) Korean web comic revealed on Saturday during its premiere at Anime Expo krage will perform the ending theme song "Everlasting" for the new season.
author: ANN

title: 'Demons' Crest' Reveals Additional Cast, Staff, Opening Theme, First Promo, November 2026 Premiere
content: The Warner Bros. Japan panel at Anime Japan 2026 revealed additional cast, staff, key visual (pictured), opening theme, and a promotional video for the Demons' Crest anime adaptation on Saturday. The anime adapting Reki Kawahara 's action fantasy light novel begins on Amazon Prime Video on November 6.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Top 3 Manhwa Live-Action Adaptations of 2026 So Far, Ranked
content: The trend of anime live-action projects has become increasingly prominent over the past few years. However, in recent years, there have been more manhwa live-action adaptations than anime live-action adaptations. This year alone has already seen the release of three major manhwa live-action adaptations on Netflix.
author: ComicBook

title: Studio Trigger Reveals 4th Project From Director Hiroyuki Imaishi, Screenwriter Kazuki Nakashima
content: Hiromi Wakabayashi will also work on the project. The event did not provide any further details about the upcoming project. The Promare film opened in 200 theaters in Japan in May 2019, and ranked at #8 in its opening weekend. The film added 4DX screenings in October 2019.
author: ANN

title: Delicious in Dungeon Anime's 2nd Season Debuts on Netflix in October 2027
content: Kadokawa announced on Sunday that the second season of Studio Trigger 's television anime of Ryōko Kui 's Delicious in Dungeon ( Dungeon Meshi ) manga will debut in October 2027 and will stream globally only on Netflix . Studio Trigger first revealed the news at Anime Expo on Saturday.
author: ANN

title: Original Anime 'Ryuugeshou no Shinobi' Announced
content: The Avex Pictures panel at Anime Expo 2026 announced a new original anime titled Ryuugeshou no Shinobi ( Jurassic Shadows ) on Saturday and revealed the main staff, concept visual (pictured), and a project promotional video.
author: MyAnimeList

title: SAO Creator Reki Kawahara's Devils' Crest Anime Adaptation Reveals First Trailer and Staff
content: Devils’ Crest , adapting another novel by Sword Art Creator Reki Kawahara, revealed the first teaser trailer, visual, voice cast and staff. The anime was announced in December 2025, with Production I.G handling the animation.
author: Anime Corner

title: Devils' Crest Anime Reveals 1st Promo Video, Theme Song Artist, November 6 Streaming Debut on Amazon Prime Video
content: Warner Bros. Japan revealed during its panel at Anime Expo on Saturday the first English-subtitled promotional video, key visual, opening theme song artist, and November 6 streaming debut on Amazon Prime Video for Devils' Crest , the television anime of Reki Kawahara 's Demons' Crest novel series.
author: ANN
